rows.why: the same bead is the structural joint AND the parting-line seal. iFixit's drilling advice for an AirTag is to aim between the three clips so you 'only go through glue' — a continuous adhesive bead on the parting line is what they found.

D3 + D13: the only Reese's-Law-compliant scheme that costs ZERO vertical height. A square detent ridge means twist alone cannot open it at any torque; the press is not a preference, it is a geometric precondition.
no coin-cell retainer under 2 mm exists (lane G). The cell is clamped between the fingers and the door, which is what Apple does and the single biggest height saving in the design.

Catley: the AirTag's board 'nests inside a gilded plastic antenna frame' and is soldered to it at four points around its edge. halo does the same, and the three board notches key the angle so the feeds land right.

params.bond: thin, STIFF, filled epoxy — the bond IS the acoustic coupling

rows.why: D11a. Full-face bonding is the point: the bender strains the crown in-plane and a curved cap turns in-plane strain into axial motion. A thick or compliant bond line would decouple it.

requires.what: a structural adhesive for the carrier-into-shell bond and the bender-onto-land bond
requires.why: the bond IS the structural joint, the parting-line seal and the acoustic coupling. No part number is chosen and no lap-shear figure is measured — connection:adhesive-bonded grades itself CANNOT DETERMINE.

requires.what: two SoC pins driven anti-phase into the Ø20 bender, at or near its 3600 Hz resonance
requires.why: DECISIONS.md D11a. This lane guarantees the mechanical path only; the drive is firmware's and the current is ce-spice's (SPEC §5 E3).

requires.what: BLE, NFC and the reserved UWB pattern, laser-direct-structured on the carrier's Ø27.60 outer wall
requires.why: this lane owns the surface and guarantees no metal is added outside the Ø31.874 envelope. The pattern, the match and the efficiency are ce-rf's (SPEC §5 E4/E5) and are CANNOT DETERMINE here.

requires.what: the 4-layer stackup, the copper and the component heights inside part:halo-pcb-blank's outline
requires.why: this lane fixes the outline (Ø26.00 x 0.60, three 26 deg notches) and two keep-outs: 0.40 mm maximum top-side component height inside Ø21.20, and nothing at all in the Ø25.75 diaphragm gap.

requires.what: the sourced CR2032's exposed positive can rim on its negative face
requires.why: the two positive fingers land at R9.50 on the assumption that the rim is exposed from about Ø18.4 to Ø20.0. Standard construction, but per-vendor. A caliper on the cell actually bought settles it.

requires.what: 16 CFR 1263's drop, torque and compression tests with the cell retained
requires.why: the two-movement geometry is measured and PASSES; the standard's test regime is physical and has not been run, so compliance is NOT claimed.
